response.sql: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) as customer_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), total_revenue AS (SELECT SUM(Total) as total_rev FROM Invoice), customer_shares AS (SELECT ct.CustomerId, ct.customer_total, ct.customer_total / tr.total_rev as customer_share FROM customer_totals ct, total_revenue tr), above_average AS (SELECT customer_total, customer_share FROM customer_shares WHERE customer_share > (SELECT AVG(customer_share) FROM customer_shares)) SELECT AVG(customer_total) as avg_amount_spent, AVG(customer_share) as avg_share, AVG(customer_share) - (SELECT AVG(customer_share) FROM customer_shares) as avg_share_beats FROM above_average
